name: Goldspire
about: Asgard, realm of light, thunder and runes. Goldspire is a hall-city above the clouds: tiered gold halls, rune-pillars crackling neon-blue, white stone going violet in the dusk, gold light pooled under every lamp. Arrival from Bifrost through the gold arch; the Thunder Hall on the north terrace; the Dawn Temple stair west; the Skyfield edge east.

portals.label: the gold arch back to Bifrost Crossing

actors.name: Envoy Ingrith Goldrune
say: Welcome to Goldspire. Mind the dark halls.

actors.name: Bodil Windmane
say: He bit you? Good. Sky-horses bite what they like.
